newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain budget deficit fell 13.2 pct in first 9 mos. [CORRECTED 11:15 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Spain budget deficit fell 13.2 pct in first 9 mos. [CORRECTED 11:15 GMT]

text.p: Spain's budget deficit fell 41 percent in September compared to the year-ago month and fell 13.2 percent in the first nine months of the year compared to the year-ago period, the Economy Ministry said in a statement.
Earlier the budget secretary erroneously told journalists that the deficit had declined by 41 percent in the first nine months of the year compared to the year-ago period.
Following table details deficit in billions of pesetas unless specified. September data are provisional.
